facts.fact: The Uganda Communications Commission, on the recommendation of the Inter-Agency Security Committee, directed all mobile operators and ISPs to suspend public internet access (social media, web browsing, video, email, messaging; mobile, fibre, fixed wireless and satellite), new SIM sales and outbound data roaming from 18:00 on 13 January 2026, to last until a written UCC restoration notice; the document gives the reason as curbing misinformation and electoral fraud during the election.

note: New Vision report published 2026-09-07 of the 13 January 2026 UCC directive.
